name: Scan a phishing lure and retain it in local history
description: Verifies a suspicious URL is scored and its scan remains visible in the same browser after navigation and reload.
steps: Analyze the URL and confirm a phishing verdict is shown
Open dashboard.html, refresh the page, and find the scanned URL in the activity table
expected: The scan result shows a high risk phishing verdict, and the URL remains in this browser’s dashboard history after reload.

name: Reject an unsupported URL scheme
covers: invalid input is not added to history
description: Verifies unsupported protocols produce a visible validation error without adding a scan record.
steps: Open dashboard.html and confirm the rejected URL is not listed
expected: The scanner shows an unsupported-protocol error and the rejected URL does not appear in scan history.

name: Submit a community report and see it in the shared feed
description: Verifies an explicitly submitted report is stored and appears in the public community feed.
steps: Enter Analyst review in the report context field and submit the threat report
Open dashboard.html and refresh the activity table
expected: A community report row appears with the submitted URL and its selected threat classification.

name: Clear local history without deleting community reports
description: Verifies the confirmed clear action removes browser-local scans while shared reports remain intact.
setup: On scanner.html, analyze https://www.wikipedia.org/ to create a local history row
steps: Open dashboard.html and confirm both entries are visible
Choose Clear Local History and confirm the action
expected: The routine Wikipedia scan is gone and the shared community report remains in the feed.

name: Scan a normal URL on mobile
description: Verifies the scanner remains usable on a phone-sized viewport and displays a result for a benign URL.
steps: Open scanner.html at the mobile viewport
Review the verdict and structural breakdown
expected: The URL is analyzed without layout overflow and the result card displays a lower-risk verdict with its URL breakdown.
